Single rehne ka sabse sukoon bhara faayda: Raat ko 11 baje phone ka charger dhoondhne ke alawa zindagi me koi doosra tension hi nahi hota!

Boyfriend: Jaan, main sach me tumhare bina ek pal bhi nahi jee sakta!
Girlfriend: Achha ji? Toh abhi 5 minute saans rok kar dikhao!
Boyfriend: Pagli, main romantic talk kar raha tha, tu toh seedha biological attack par utar aayi!

First date par restaurant me:
Boyfriend: Tum apne liye kya order karogi?
Girlfriend: Main toh bas green tea aur cucumber salad leti hoon...
Shaadi ke 6 mahine baad: 'Suno, aate waqt 2 plate chhole kulche aur 1 kilo gulab jamun lete aana, bhookh lag rahi hai!'
notes: First date salad vs post marriage appetite.

content: Crush ne bas hallway me chalte huye ek second ke liye dekh kar halki si smile kya di... ladke ne dimaag me shaadi ka venue, 2 bachho ke naam aur future home loan tak plan kar liya!
Biryani lovers ka dard: Dum Biryani khate waqt daant ke neeche elaichi ka aana bilkul waisa hi hai, jaise climax romantic scene ke beech me YouTube par 20 second ka non-skippable ad aa jaye!
Desi dieting struggle: Subah se oats aur boiled egg khaye, shaam ko gali ke mod par golgappe wale ka thela dekh kar aatma ne bagawat kar di aur 4 plate teekhe paani-puri pel diye!

Doctor: Health theek rakhni hai toh din bhar me bas ek chhota cup chai piya karo.
Patient: Theek hai doctor sahab, maine market se 1 litre capacity wala beer mug khareed liya hai, ab usi me chai pita hoon!
notes: One cup of chai with 1-litre mug.

content: 1st January ko high motivation ke sath 1 saal ki gym membership li. 2nd January ko pure shareer me itna khatarnak dard hua ki toothpaste ka dhakkan kholne ke liye bhi roommate ki madad leni padi!

Trainer: Weight loss karna hai toh roz 5 km running ke baad sugar-free green tea piyo.
Client: Sir green tea ke saath do garam samose aur meethi chutney chalegi kya?
Modern gym workout schedule: 5 minute cardio, 5 minute dumbbell, aur agle 50 minute tak gym ke bade mirror ke saamne biceps flex karke 100 selfies aur 4 reels shoot karna!

TT ne platform par pakad liya: Ticket dikhao!
Yatri: Arre main train me baith kar aaya hi nahi!
TT: Is baat ka kya saboot hai tumhare paas?
Yatri: Saboot yahi hai sir ki mere paas ticket nahi hai!

Pappu: Yaar kal raat train me mujhe bilkul neend nahi aayi. Ek toh upper berth mili thi aur upar se garmi bohot thi.
Dost: Arre toh neeche kisi se seat exchange kar leta na!
Pappu: Kisse exchange karta bhai? Neeche wali seat par koi tha hi nahi!
notes: Could not exchange empty lower berth.

content: Indian train journey ka niyam: Train platform chhodte hi pehle seat ke neeche lohe ki chain se suitcase lock karenge, aur theek 5 minute baad poora parivaar aloo ke parathe aur aam ka achaar khol kar khana shuru kar dega!
notes: Paratha and chain lock in train.

content:
Cycle wale ne paidal ja rahe aadmi ko takkar maar di aur bola: 'Bhai sahab, aap bohot kismat wale ho!'
Ghayal aadmi: 'Ek toh takkar maari aur upar se kehta hai kismat wala hoon?'
Cycle wala: 'Haan bhai, kyu ki aaj meri truck ki chhutti thi, warna socho kya hota!'
notes: Lucky it was a bicycle not truck.

content:
Traffic Police: Helmet kyu nahi pehna?
Biker: Sir bas yahan saamne wali gali me hi jaa raha tha.
Police: Toh kya Yamraj runway se flight leke aayenge? Wo bhi yahin saamne wali gali me hi ghoom rahe hain!

Auto meter par 70 rupaye bane.
Auto Driver: Sahab 120 rupaye de do.
Passenger: Meter par toh 70 dikha raha hai!
Auto Driver: Sahab aate waqt wahan se khaali aana padega, uska return fare kaun dega!

Teacher: Exam ke 3 ghante me student ka dimaag sabse tez aur active kab chalta hai?
Student: Sir jab invigilator dusri taraf muh karke zordar khansi karta hai!

Student exam hall se haste hue seeti bajate bahar aaya.
Dost: Bhai paper kaisa gaya?
Student: Ekdum zabardast! Pehla sawal chhoot gaya, doosra aata nahi tha, teesre me galat likh diya, baaki sab first class!
Exam hall ke aakhri 15 minute: Jo bachha poore 2 ghante se ceiling fan ko dekh raha tha, wo achanak chillata hai: 'Sir supplement sheet lao jaldi!' Aur usme Bollywood movie ki kahani pel deta hai!
notes: Writing Bollywood stories on supplement sheet.

content:
Teacher: Pappu batao, India Gate kya hai?
Pappu: Sir, India Gate best quality ke basmati chawal hain!
Teacher (hairaan): Aur Charminar kya hai?
Pappu: Sir wo bohot mashhoor beedi ka brand hai!
notes: India Gate basmati rice and Charminar.

content:
Pappu dukaan par gaya: Bhaiya ek shampoo ka bottle dena.
Dukaanwale ne bottle di.
Pappu: Is par likha hai 'For Dry Hair'... mere baal toh abhi paani se bheege hain, koi geele baalon wala shampoo dikhao!

Doctor: Pappu, tum roz subah jogging kyu nahi karte?
Pappu: Doctor sahab, jab pairon ko achhe se pata hai ki ghoom-fir kar wapas yahin aana hai, toh faltu me petrol kyu jalana!
notes: Why jog if you have to come back.

content:
Banta: Santa tu khaali pet kitne kele kha sakta hai?
Santa: Main 6 kele kha sakta hoon.
Banta: Galat! Pehla kela khane ke baad pet khaali kahan bacha! Isliye tu bas ek hi kela kha sakta hai.
Santa ghar gaya aur biwi se poochha: Tu khaali pet kitne kele kha sakti hai?
Biwi: Main 4 kha sakti hoon.
Santa: Dhhatt teri ki! Agar 6 bolti toh ek mast joke sunata!

Banta: Yaar Santa, petrol itna zyada mehenga ho gaya hai, desh me kitna aakrosh hai!
Santa: Mujhe toh koi farak nahi padta bhai. Main pehle bhi 500 ka hi dalwata tha, aur aaj bhi 500 ka hi dalwata hoon!

Santa computer institute gaya.
Teacher: Agar window band karni ho toh kone me bane red cross par click karo.
Santa ne seedhe monitor par hathoda maar diya: 'Sir screen tod di hai, ab batao mouse kahan ghumaun?'

Question: Nadi ke beech me nimbu ka ped laga hai, nimbu kaise todoge?
Answer: Chidiya ban kar ud kar todunga!
Question: Par tumhe chidiya kaun banayega?
Answer: Wahi jo nadi ke beech me nimbu ka ped lagayega!

Question: Doctor aur Vakil ke peshe me kya bada antar hai?
Answer: Vakil chahta hai aap musibat me faso aur doctor chahta hai aap beemar pado, par dono me ek badi similarity hai: Dono ki fees par 1 rupaye ka bhi discount nahi milta!

Question: Ek machhar doosre machhar se weekend par kya bolta hai?
Answer: Chalo kisi badi wedding party me chalte hain, aaj raat sabka meetha khoon peeyenge!
Dentist Simran ka daant nikaalne ke baad muskura kar bola: 'JAW Simran JAW, jee le apni zindagi!'

Question: How do you say 'She is calling an Uber cab' in just one English word?
Answer: 'VOCABULARY' (Vo cab bula rahi)!
notes: Vocabulary vo cab bula rahi pun.

content:
Question: How do you politely request your Maasi to take a holy dip in the river?
Answer: 'DIPLOMACY' (Dip lo Maasi)!

Question: What did one scientific calculator say to the other calculator in the morning?
Answer: 'CASIO!' (Kaisi ho?)

Pati: Main laptop par PowerPoint presentation bana raha hoon.
Patni: Remote ka cell down ho gaya hai, market se ek EXCEL leke aana!

Dost: Bhai sardi bohot hai, maine pichhle teen din se nahaya nahi hai!
Me: Arre chinta mat kar bhai, 'Koi BATH nahi'!
Last night I ate super fiery spicy garlic chutney with parathas. This morning in the bathroom, I finally learnt my 'LEHSUN'!
Mera dimaag bilkul Google Search Engine ki tarah hi superfast hai, bas jab exam hall me baithta hoon tab screen par 'No Internet Connection' dikha deta hai!

Dost: Naye kapde pehne hain, sach bata main kaisa lag raha hoon?
Me: Bilkul Bollywood ka action hero lag raha hai bhai, bas background me thoda dukh bhara music bajna chahiye!
Duniya ke gyaani log kehte hain ki 'Paisa sab kuch nahi hota'... par jab mahine ke end me wallet kholo toh pata chalta hai ki wahi sach me sab kuch hota tha!

Dad: Beta kal school kyu nahi gaya tha?
Son: Papa teacher ne bola tha ki kal class me 'Surprise Test' hoga. Agar main school chala jaata toh becharon ka surprise kharab ho jaata na!
Dad: Wah beta, itne nek vichaar ke liye ye flying chappal gift me le lo!

Dad sofa par baithe hue: Beta zara ek glass paani lana.
Beta paani laata hai.
Dad: Thanda nahi hai.
Beta fridge se laata hai.
Dad: Thoda normal mix kar de.
Beta: Papa seedhe bol do na ki aalas aa raha tha aur mujhe exercise karwani thi!
Chhote bachhe ne mandir me haath jod kar prarthana ki: 'Hey bhagwan ji, bas is baar Geography ke paper me Delhi ko Japan ki capital bana do, main answer sheet me wahi likh kar aaya hoon!'
notes: Student prayer to make Delhi capital of Japan.

content:
Chintu: Mummy, main bada hokar pilot banunga aur hawa me plane udaunga!
Mummy: Beta pehle homework khatam kar le, warna papa ke purane scooter par poora shehar ghoomna padega!

Dadi: Beta prasad me kya loge, motichoor laddoo ya kaju katli?
Pappu: Dadi bhagwan ke ghar me bhedbhav nahi karte, dono barabar-barabar meri plate me daal do!

Padosi: Bhaisahab, ye lijiye Diwali ki shubhkaamnaayein aur ye meetha tohfa!
Hum (dabba dekh kar man me): Arre nahi! Ye toh wahi Soan Papdi ka dabba hai jo pichhle saal maine Sharma ji ko diya tha, Sharma ji ne Verma ji ko aur Verma ji ne inko diya tha!
Diwali par Soan Papdi koi mithaai nahi hai, balki wo ek circulating football hai jise har parivaar doosre ke paale me pass karne ke liye hi khareedta hai!
Holi ka niyam: Subah aisi t-shirt pehno jise pichhle 5 saal se pocha banane ki koshish ki ja rahi ho, taaki rang lagne ke baad fenkte waqt aatma ko shanti mile!
Gully cricket ka samvidhanik niyam: Jis ladke ka bat hoga, pehli batting usi ki hogi... chahe pehli ball par clean bowled ho jaye, wo use trial ball bol kar dobara khelega!

Bowler: Bhai catch le liya, tu out hai!
Batsman: Arre pagal ho gaya hai kya? Gully ke rule ke hisaab se agar ball naali me girne ke baad pakdi jaye toh wo 'Dead Ball' hoti hai, out nahi!
Gully cricket me sabse bada khauf bowling ya bouncer ka nahi hota... balki us saamne wale ghar ki aunty ka hota hai jinke terrace par ball jaate hi ball zapt ho jaati hai!

Gabbar: Arre o Kalia, kitne aadmi the?
Kalia: Sarkar, poore do aadmi the!
Gabbar: Toh khaali haath kyu laut aaye?
Kalia: Wo sarkaar, aapke dialogue maarte-maarte dono hero bike start karke nikal gaye!

Basanti: Bhaag Dhanno bhaag, aaj teri Basanti ki izzat ka sawal hai!
Dhanno (ghodi): Arre Basanti, izzat toh teri bach jayegi, par pichhle 5 kilometer se daud-daud kar meri tangon me fracture ho jayega!

Gabbar: Ye haath mujhe de de Thakur!
Thakur: Le le bhai bina dare le le, par pehle ye bata ki jab bartan dhone ki baari aayegi toh kaun dhoega!

Daily morning routine: Subah 6:00 baje alarm baje toh Snooze kiya, 6:15 par Snooze, 6:30 par Snooze... achanak aankh khuli toh 8:45 baj chuke the aur baaki ka routine 100 meter Olympic sprint ban gaya!
Ghar ka darwaza lock karte waqt ki pavitra prathmikta: Phone, Wallet, aur Chabi... agar inme se ek bhi jeb me na mile toh darwaze se wapas bhaagna hi param shanti hai!
notes: Checking phone wallet keys before leaving.

content:
Barber baal kaatne ke baad mirror dikhata hai: 'Bhaiya theek hai na?'
Chahe usne baalon ka pineapple bana diya ho, dil se bas ek hi jhooth nikalta hai: 'Haan bhaiya, ekdum perfect!'

Desi restaurant rule: Restaurant me baith kar 10 minute tak Chinese, Continental aur Italian ka poora menu padhenge... aur ant me waiter aate hi bolenge: 'Bhaiya ek Paneer Butter Masala aur 3 Butter Naan le aao!'
notes: Reading entire menu to order paneer.

content:
Photographer 6 saal ke Chintu se bola: Beta camera ki taraf dekho, abhi isme se kabootar niklega!
Chintu: Bewakoofon jaisi baatein mat kar uncle, lighting dekh, portrait mode laga, ISO 200 par rakh aur 4K me click kar!

Mummy: Aaj school ke tiffin me lauki ki sabzi di thi, kha kar kyu nahi aaya?
Chintu: Mummy maine bohot koshish ki, par lauki tiffin box se bahar aane ke liye taiyyar hi nahi hui!

Papa: Beta tera report card kahan hai?
Chintu: Papa wo maine dost ko kiraye par de diya hai.
Papa: Kiraye par kyu?
Chintu: Uska report card achha aa gaya tha, aur aaj uska papa se maar khane ka mood ho raha tha!
Adult life ka sach: 30 ki umra paar karte hi shareer ke joints weather forecast center ban jaate hain... barish shuru hone se aadha ghanta pehle hi kamar aur ghutna bol padta hai!
30 saal ke home loan lene ke baad insaan jitni wafadaari aur obedience bank manager ko dikhata hai, utni toh pet dog bhi apne maalik ko nahi dikhata!
notes: Home loan EMI and bank obedience.

content:
Doctor: Aapki age kya hai?
Patient: Doctor sahab, Aadhar Card par 31 likha hai, par subah so kar uthte waqt feel bilkul 70 saal ke pensioner jaisa hota hai!
notes: Aadhar card age vs morning fatigue.

content: Golgappe wale bhaiya se paani-puri khatam hone ke baad hath aage karke 'Bhaiya ek extra sukhi papdi dena masala daal ke' maangna har bhartiya ka samvidhanik adhikar hai!
Chai ki tapri par 10 rupaye ki cutting chai haath me lekar do desi dost poori duniya ki geopolitics, Indian cricket team selection aur share market ka mustaqbil 7 minute me decide kar dete hain!
notes: Tapri chai discussions solving world problems.

content:
Patni neend se uthte hi romantic hokar boli: Sunte ho ji? Mujhe abhi sapna aaya ki aap mere liye heeron ka chamchamata haar leke aaye ho!
Pati: Theek hai, toh jaldi se wapas so jao aur pehan kar ghoomo!
notes: Go back to sleep and wear diamond necklace.

content:
Pati (gusse me shaq karte hue): Tune meri chai me taweez kyu daal rakha hai? Mujhe vash me karne ke liye?
Patni: Pagal ho gaye ho kya, ye taweez nahi, Green Tea ka Tea-Bag hai!

Patni: Tum har ladai me mere maayke walo ko beech me kyu kheench laate ho?
Pati: Dekho, jab TV me koi technical kharab aati hai toh TV ko thodi dosh dete hain, gaali toh company walo ko hi padti hai!

Pati badam kha raha tha.
Biwi: Suno na, mujhe bhi taste karao!
Pati ne jeb se ek badam nikaal kar biwi ko de diya.
Biwi: Bas ek hi badam doge?
Pati: Haan, kyu ki baaki sabka bhi taste bilkul aisa hi hai!

Pati: Yaar bohot pyaas lagi hai, ek glass paani le aao.
Patni: Kyu na aaj main tumhare liye matar paneer aur shahi pulao banau?
Pati: Waah! Muh me paani aa gaya!
Patni: Bas aa gaya na paani? Usi se kaam chala lo!

Teacher: Pappu batao, chipkali kise kehte hain?
Pappu: Chipkali ek bohot gareeb magarmachh hai sir, jise bachpan me Bournvita wala doodh nahi mila, isliye bechari kuposhan ka shikar ho gayi!
notes: Lizard is a poor crocodile without Bournvita.

content:
Teacher: Kal main class me sooraj (sun) par lecture dene jaa rahi hoon, koi class miss mat karna.
Pappu: Madam main nahi aa paunga.
Teacher: Kyu?
Pappu: Wo kya hai na madam, meri mummy mujhe itni dhoop me itni door jaane hi nahi dengi!
notes: Mother wont allow going to the sun in the heat.

content:
Teacher: Hindi me Ghazal aur Bhashan me kya antar hai?
Pappu: Sir, parayi aurat ka har shabd ghazal lagta hai aur apni biwi ka har shabd bhashan!

Doctor: Jab tum depression aur stress me hote ho, toh kya karte ho?
Mareez: Ji main mandir chala jaata hoon.
Doctor: Waah, wahan jaakar dhyaan aur dhyan-lagate ho?
Mareez: Ji nahi, mandir ke baahar sab logo ke joote-chappal aapas me mix kar deta hoon... phir un logo ko gusse me pareshaan dekh kar mera stress chhoo-mantar ho jaata hai!
notes: Mixing slippers at temple for stress relief.

content:
Doctor marne ke baad upar swarg pahuncha, wahan use apna purana mareez mil gaya.
Mareez: Doctor sahab, ab toh hum dono mar chuke hain, ab toh sach bata do... aakhir mujhe beemari kya thi?!

Pappu: Doctor sahab, koi badhiya dawaai dijiye, bohot zordar sar dard ho raha hai!
Doctor: Is waqt aapko aaraam aur shaanti ki sabse zyada zaroorat hai. Main neend ki goliya likh raha hoon, roz raat ko apni biwi ko doodh me mila kar pila dena!
notes: Sleeping pills for wife to cure husband headache.

content:
Santa clinic gaya: Doctor sahab, ghar aakar patient check karne ki kya fees hai?
Doctor: 300 rupaye.
Santa: Theek hai chaliye.
Doctor apni gaadi se Santa ke ghar pahuncha aur poochha: Mareez kahan hai?
Santa: Arre koi mareez nahi hai doctor sahab, taxi wala 500 maang raha tha aur aap 300 me chhod aaye!
notes: Using doctor house call as cheap taxi.

content:
Santa: Mujhe apni biwi se talak chahiye, wo roz bartan phenk kar maarti hai.
Banta: Ye toh pichhle 3 saal se phenk rahi hai, ab achanak talak kyu?
Santa: Kyu ki ab uska nishana pakka ho gaya hai!

Banta ko phoot-phoot kar rota dekh Santa ne poochha: Tu itna kyu ro raha hai bhai, kya padosi ke haathi se bohot pyaar karta tha?
Banta: Pyaar nahi karta tha bhai, mujhe uski qabr khodne ka theka mila hai!

Professor: Semester system se students ko kya asar padta hai?
Student: Fayda toh pata nahi sir, par saal me ek ki jagah do baar beizzati jhelne ki aadat pad jaati hai!
notes: Twice a year insult in semester system.

content:
External Viva Examiner: Newton ka teesra niyam (Third Law) kya hai?
Student: Sir shuruat ki lines toh bhool gaya, bas aakhri line pakki yaad hai.
Examiner: Chalo aakhri line hi suna do!
Student: '...aur isi ko Newton ka teesra niyam kehte hain!'
notes: Last line of Newton law in viva.

content:
Teacher: Sanju batao, 'Itihaas' (History) kise kehte hain?
Sanju: Sir jab purane jamane ke log kand karke mar jaate hain aur unki galtiyon ki saza exam me hume yaad karke bhugtani padti hai, use itihaas kehte hain!
notes: History definition based on ancestors kand.

content:
Teacher: Pedon aur jungle ki katai rokne ka koi solid upay batao.
Student: Sir saare school aur college exams cancel kar do, hazaro ton paper bachega aur jungle bach jayenge!

Employee: Sir, mujhe turant 30% salary hike chahiye, kyu ki aaj kal do bohot badi companiyan mere peeche lagi hui hain!
Boss (hairaan hokar): Kaun si companiyan?
Employee: Ek bijli ke bill wali aur doosri paani ke bill wali!

Employee: HR ma'am, meri salary thodi aur badha dijiye.
HR: Par pichhle mahine hi toh tumhe hike mili thi!
Employee: Ma'am wo hike toh maine us nayi car ki EMI bharne ke liye li thi jo maine pichhli hike milne ki khushi me khareed li thi!

Corporate office meeting ka ajeeb dukh: 1 ghante ki meeting me sirf 5 minute kaam ki baat hoti hai, aur baaki 55 minute ye decide karne me nikal jaate hain ki agali meeting kab aur kis time par rakhni hai!

Bhai (Raksha Bandhan par baithkar): Behna ab aarti utar kar rakhi baandh bhi de!
Behen: Kalai peeche karo bhaiya, pehle 5000 rupaye GPay karo, screenshot verified dekhne ke baad hi dori bandhegi!
notes: Online GPay payment before tying Rakhi.

content:
Bhai: Tu itni der se kamre ka darwaza band karke kisse ghanto baat kar rahi hai?
Behen: Jisse bhi karu, tujhe kya matlab?
Bhai: Achha theek hai, toh agle mahine ka Wi-Fi recharge bhi usi se karwa lena, main password badal raha hoon!
notes: Brother threatening to change Wi-Fi password.

content:
Ladka: Bhai aaj poori himmat juta kar college me crush ko rose dekar propose kiya tha!
Dost: Phir kya hua bhai?
Ladka: Us chudail ne bag se rakhi nikaal kar meri kalai par baandh di aur boli 'I love you mere pyare bhaiya'!
notes: Crush tying rakhi instead of accepting proposal.

content: Desi middle class kitchen ki parampara: Har ghar me ek aisi 'Mahabali Plastic Thaili' hoti hai jiske pet ke andar pichhle 5 saalon ki 200 aur thailiyan thhuns kar rakhi hoti hain, taaki aane wali agali teen peedhiyon ko kabhi polythene ki kami na ho!
Zindagi me ek desi insaan ko sabse gehra dukh tab hota hai, jab garam chai me duboya hua Parle-G biscuit muh tak pahunchne se theek ek second pehle pyali ke andar toot kar shaheed ho jata hai!

Gully cricket ka niyam no. 7: Agar batsman ke zordar shot se ball saamne wali naali me chali gayi, toh batsman out nahi hoga... par naali me ghus kar ball nikaalne aur use paani se dhone ki saza usi batsman ki hogi!
source_name: Times of India & Gully Cricket Chronicles

content: Gully cricket boundary rule: Deewar ko direct ball lagi toh six run... par agar ball deewar taap kar padosi Sharma ji ke veranda me giri toh batsman out, aur Sharma ji se daant kha kar ball wapas laane ka risk bhi usi ka!
source_name: Times of India & Gully Cricket Chronicles
notes: Wall six vs neighbor veranda out.
